About the M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy

With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted using a jungle tiger hydrographic. The M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy is a Classified-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Atomic Alloy finish on the M4A1-S. With a Classified rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.64% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy can be unboxed from the Huntsman Weapon Case. It belongs to the Huntsman Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.90. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $214.16, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $33.00 (Field-Tested) to $214.16 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy has a community rating of 3.9 out of 5 based on 281 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among M4A1-S skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy?

Factory New (FN) M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Atomic Alloy pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy worth the price?

The M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Atomic Alloy design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Huntsman Collection, obtainable from the Huntsman Weapon Case, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the M4A1-S, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.90, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy?

Prices for the M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. Can I use the M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.
